strings.zh: 冠军大人,{NEWLINE}白银大会马上就要开始了,{CLEAR}请问您做好准备了吗？
strings.en: Champion, the Silver Conference is{NEWLINE}about to begin. Are you ready?
strings.notes: Mt. Silver summit: the first Silver Conference (before the Team Rocket war in 0126/0466). The Champion (player) defends at the summit; Lance and Lorelei screen challengers (assessment → Ace Trainer status); the first eight up get a one-on-one match.

strings.zh: 请冠军大人抓紧时间。
strings.en: Please hurry, Champion.

strings.zh: 好的,我现在通知山下的主持人。
strings.en: Very well. I’ll notify the MC at the foot{NEWLINE}of the mountain now.

strings.zh: 好了,各位参赛选手,{NEWLINE}规则到此就宣读完毕了。{CLEAR}白银山上的冠军和四天王{CLEAR}已经做好了准备{CLEAR}等待大家的挑战。{CLEAR}下面请各位拿出十二分的状态,{CLEAR}以联盟冠军为目标{CLEAR}向神秘的白银山进发吧！
strings.en: All right, competitors, that concludes{NEWLINE}the reading of the rules.{SCROLL}The Champion and the Elite Four are{NEWLINE}ready and waiting for your challenge{CLEAR}atop Mt. Silver.{SCROLL}Now, bring your very best, set your{NEWLINE}sights on the League Champion, and head{CLEAR}for mysterious Mt. Silver!

strings.zh: 我听下面的主持人反馈说{NEWLINE}选手们已经出发了,{CLEAR}不知道第一位到这儿的会是谁呢。{SCROLL}有哪位选手是冠军大人{NEWLINE}特别期待的吗？
strings.en: The MC down below reports that the{NEWLINE}competitors have set off. I wonder{CLEAR}who’ll be the first to get here.{SCROLL}Is there a competitor you’re especially{NEWLINE}looking forward to, Champion?
strings.notes: Branch: #12–#14 menu (which competitor the player expects): Gold → #5/#6/#8, Crystal → #15/#16/#21, Silver → #17–#20.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『我虽然不太清楚{NEWLINE}报名参赛的都有谁,{CLEAR}但我敢肯定有一位来自若叶镇的少年{CLEAR}会表现得非常抢眼。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: I don’t really know who all{NEWLINE}signed up.{SCROLL}But I’m sure a certain boy from New{NEWLINE}Bark Town is going to stand out.

strings.zh: 哦？冠军大人不是关东真新镇人吗？{NEWLINE}居然会关注城都地区的小镇少年啊。
strings.en: Oh? Aren’t you from Pallet Town in{NEWLINE}Kanto, Champion?{SCROLL}You’re keeping an eye on a small-town{NEWLINE}boy from Johto?

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『最近一年{NEWLINE}我都在城都地区旅行,{CLEAR}所以认识了不少那边的人。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: I’ve been traveling around{NEWLINE}Johto for the past year, so I got to{CLEAR}know quite a few people there.

strings.zh: 原来如此啊。{SCROLL}不知道那位少年{NEWLINE}能不能回应冠军大人的期待,{CLEAR}第一个到达这里。
strings.en: I see.{SCROLL}I wonder if that boy can live up to your{NEWLINE}expectations and be the first to{CLEAR}get here.

strings.zh: 阿金『嗯……这些人头也不回地{NEWLINE}就往东边走了,{CLEAR}看来东边应该是上山的正确道路。
strings.en: Gold: Hmm... All these people went{NEWLINE}straight east without looking back.{SCROLL}So east must be the right way up the{NEWLINE}mountain.

strings.zh: 阿金『小银这家伙诡计多端,{NEWLINE}别人都往东走他偏往西走,{CLEAR}说明那边肯定有上山的捷径,{CLEAR}我要跟上去看看！
strings.en: Gold: That sneaky Silver... Everyone{NEWLINE}else is heading east, but he’s{CLEAR}going west.{SCROLL}That means there’s gotta be a shortcut{NEWLINE}up the mountain that way. I’m{CLEAR}following him!

strings.zh: 水晶『阿金和小银去西边了？{NEWLINE}那边也能……上山吗？
strings.en: Crystal: Gold and Silver went west? Can{NEWLINE}you... get up the mountain that{CLEAR}way too?

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『我虽然不太清楚{NEWLINE}报名参赛的都有谁,{CLEAR}但我想一定会有一位{CLEAR}以打倒我为目标的红发少年,{CLEAR}凭借他的勇猛和果决{CLEAR}在大会上取得佳绩。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: I don’t really know who all{NEWLINE}signed up.{SCROLL}But I bet there’ll be a redheaded boy{NEWLINE}whose goal is to beat me.{SCROLL}He’ll do great here, thanks to his{NEWLINE}courage and his resolve.

strings.zh: 哦？还真有人觉得{NEWLINE}自己能打败冠军大人啊,{CLEAR}也太不自量力了。
strings.en: Oh? Someone actually thinks they can{NEWLINE}beat you, Champion?{SCROLL}Talk about not knowing your limits.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『我在最近一年的旅行中,{NEWLINE}见证了这位少年{CLEAR}从实力到心智的不断成熟,{CLEAR}如果跟他交战时大意的话,{CLEAR}搞不好还真有可能会输掉。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Over my travels this past{NEWLINE}year, I’ve watched that boy mature, in{CLEAR}both skill and spirit.{SCROLL}If I let my guard down when I battle{NEWLINE}him, I might really lose.

strings.zh: 啊呀,这么厉害的吗？{SCROLL}希望知道那位少年{NEWLINE}能回应冠军大人的期待,{CLEAR}第一个到达这里吧。
strings.en: Oh my, is he that good?{SCROLL}I hope that boy lives up to your{NEWLINE}expectations and gets here first.

strings.zh: 原来如此啊。{SCROLL}不知道那个女孩{NEWLINE}能不能回应冠军大人的期待,{CLEAR}第一个到达这里。
strings.en: I see.{SCROLL}I wonder if that girl can live up to your{NEWLINE}expectations and be the first to{CLEAR}get here.

strings.zh: 水晶『呃……{NEWLINE}有你们开路倒是轻松很多。
strings.en: Crystal: Uh... Having you two clear the{NEWLINE}way does make things a lot easier.

strings.zh: 拉达『Raa……
strings.en: Raticate: Raa...

strings.zh: 已经到极限了吗……？{SCROLL}能走到这里已经很不错了,{NEWLINE}谢谢你,拉达！
strings.en: Is this your limit...?{SCROLL}Making it this far is already great.{NEWLINE}Thank you, Raticate!

strings.zh: 小黄『呀,你的拉达伤的有点重啊。
strings.en: Yellow: Oh, your Raticate is pretty{NEWLINE}badly hurt.

strings.zh: 没办法,白银山的野生精灵太厉害了,{NEWLINE}能走到这里我已经很知足了。
strings.en: Can’t be helped. Mt. Silver’s wild{NEWLINE}Pokémon are just too strong.{SCROLL}I’m happy I made it this far.

strings.zh: 小黄『我来帮你的拉达恢复一下吧。
strings.en: Yellow: Let me heal your Raticate a{NEWLINE}little.

strings.zh: 哎？恢复？不是禁止带伤药……？
strings.en: Huh? Heal it? But aren’t Potions{NEWLINE}banned...?
strings.notes: RV051: name: 伤药 = Potion (glossary)

strings.zh: 拉达『Raaaa——ti！
strings.en: Raticate: Raaaa-ti!

strings.zh: 拉达的体力恢复了！？太神奇了吧？
strings.en: Raticate’s energy is back!? That’s{NEWLINE}amazing!

strings.zh: 小黄『嘿嘿,看到你的拉达{NEWLINE}就不禁让我想起我的那只拉达。{CLEAR}那是一位非常重要的人{CLEAR}送给我的人生中的第一只精灵。
strings.en: Yellow: Hee hee, seeing your Raticate{NEWLINE}reminds me of my own Raticate.{SCROLL}It was the first Pokémon I ever had, a{NEWLINE}gift from someone very important to me.

strings.zh: 小黄『啊呀,不知不觉说了这么多,{NEWLINE}我得继续前进了。{CLEAR}你也加油吧！
strings.en: Yellow: Oops, I got carried away{NEWLINE}talking. I have to keep going.{SCROLL}Good luck to you too!

strings.zh: 科拿『从你对待精灵的态度{NEWLINE}和你个人的言行来看,{CLEAR}都过于急功近利,{CLEAR}我不能授予你精英训练家资格。{CLEAR}你回去历练历练再来吧。
strings.en: Lorelei: From the way you treat your{NEWLINE}Pokémon, and from your own words and{CLEAR}actions, you’re far too hungry for{CLEAR}quick success.{SCROLL}I can’t grant you Ace Trainer status.{SCROLL}Go get some more experience and come{NEWLINE}back.

strings.zh: 啊……怎么这样……
strings.en: Ah... No way...

strings.zh: 渡『你不仅对战实力出众,{NEWLINE}对自己的精灵也很了解和爱惜,{CLEAR}我认可你了。{CLEAR}恭喜你成为本届大会{CLEAR}第一位登顶的训练家！
strings.en: Lance: You’re not only an outstanding{NEWLINE}battler, you also know and care for{CLEAR}your Pokémon well. I acknowledge you.{SCROLL}Congratulations on being the first{NEWLINE}Trainer at this Conference to reach{CLEAR}the summit!

strings.zh: 谢谢渡先生的认可！
strings.en: Thank you, Lance!

strings.zh: 喂喂喂！{NEWLINE}我们两个刚才都打输了,{CLEAR}为什么他能通过我就要回去！
strings.en: Hey, hey, hey! We both just lost!{SCROLL}So why does he get through while I have{NEWLINE}to go home?!

strings.zh: 渡『你还不明白吗？{NEWLINE}成为精英训练家除了实力之外,{CLEAR}你的心智也很重要。{CLEAR}如果这都理解不了,{CLEAR}那你就更需要回去好好反思一下了！
strings.en: Lance: You still don’t get it?{SCROLL}Becoming an Ace Trainer takes more than{NEWLINE}strength. Your character matters too.{SCROLL}If you can’t even understand that,{NEWLINE}then you really need to go home and{CLEAR}take a hard look at yourself!
Ah... *sigh*...

strings.zh: 渡『哦？你不是上届{NEWLINE}石英大会的冠军小黄吗？{CLEAR}你也来参加白银大会了啊。
strings.en: Lance: Oh? Aren’t you Yellow, the{NEWLINE}winner of last year’s{CLEAR}Indigo Conference?{SCROLL}So you’ve entered the Silver{NEWLINE}Conference too.

strings.zh: 小黄『啊……嗯,我听说这届大会{NEWLINE}不用打败四天王{CLEAR}也可以向联盟冠军挑战。{CLEAR}所以就想来跟……{CLEAR}跟联盟冠军对战试试。
strings.en: Yellow: Ah... Yes. I heard that at this{NEWLINE}Conference, you can challenge the{CLEAR}League Champion without beating the{CLEAR}Elite Four.{SCROLL}So I wanted to try battling... battling{NEWLINE}the League Champion.

strings.zh: 渡『哈哈,好、好。{NEWLINE}让我看看你这一年来又进步了多少。
strings.en: Lance: Ha ha, good, good. Let me see{NEWLINE}how much you’ve grown this past year.

strings.zh: 小蓝『嘿嘿嘿,科拿女士,{NEWLINE}我的对手是你吗？
strings.en: Green: Heh heh heh. Ms. Lorelei, are{NEWLINE}you my opponent?

strings.zh: 小赤『你好,科拿女士,{NEWLINE}我的对手是你吗？
strings.en: Red: Hello, Ms. Lorelei. Are you my{NEWLINE}opponent?

strings.zh: 科拿『你是跟{VAR:0103:0}同一届{NEWLINE}成为精英训练家的那位小蓝？
strings.en: Lorelei: You’re Green, who became an{NEWLINE}Ace Trainer the same year as {VAR:0103:0}?

strings.zh: 科拿『你是跟{VAR:0103:0}同一届{NEWLINE}成为精英训练家的那位小赤？
strings.en: Lorelei: You’re Red, who became an Ace{NEWLINE}Trainer the same year as {VAR:0103:0}?

strings.zh: 小蓝『哎呀,能给四天王{NEWLINE}留下这么深的印象,{CLEAR}我还真是受宠若惊呢。
strings.en: Green: Oh my, to leave such an{NEWLINE}impression on one of the Elite Four...{CLEAR}I’m flattered.

strings.zh: 小赤『当时我并没有获得{NEWLINE}挑战四天王的资格,{CLEAR}没想到您居然能认得我。
strings.en: Red: Back then, I didn’t earn the right{NEWLINE}to challenge the Elite Four.{SCROLL}I never expected you to recognize me.

strings.zh: 科拿『你们在淘汰赛的对战{NEWLINE}我们四天都通过电视转播看到了,{CLEAR}你跟一树的那场对战{CLEAR}让我印象很深呢。{CLEAR}我对你的实力可是非常期待的。
strings.en: Lorelei: We Elite Four all watched your{NEWLINE}knockout-round battles on TV.{SCROLL}Your battle with Will left quite an{NEWLINE}impression on me.{SCROLL}I have high hopes for what you can do.
strings.notes: zh 我们四天 read as 我们四天王 (the Elite Four).

strings.zh: 小蓝『嘿嘿,那我可就全力攻击了,{NEWLINE}你要小心咯！
strings.en: Green: Heh heh, then I’ll attack with{NEWLINE}everything I’ve got. Better watch out!

strings.zh: 小赤『是,我会认真对待跟您的对战,{NEWLINE}请您也使出全力吧！
strings.en: Red: Yes. I’ll take our battle{NEWLINE}seriously. Please give it your all, too!

strings.zh: 我听到山洞里好像传来了脚步声,{NEWLINE}是不是已经有选手{CLEAR}通过了四天王的检定？
strings.en: I think I hear footsteps coming from{NEWLINE}the cave.{SCROLL}Has a competitor already passed the{NEWLINE}Elite Four’s assessment?

strings.zh: 呼！这就是白银山的山顶吗？{NEWLINE}白雪飘飘地好壮观啊！
strings.en: Whew! So this is Mt. Silver’s summit?{SCROLL}All this falling snow is breathtaking!

strings.zh: 恭喜您成为第一位{NEWLINE}来到白银山顶的参赛选手,{CLEAR}请问您现在有何感想呢？
strings.en: Congratulations on being the first{NEWLINE}competitor to reach the summit of{CLEAR}Mt. Silver!{SCROLL}How do you feel right now?

strings.zh: 啊？嗯……这个嘛……
strings.en: Huh? Um... Well...
Yellow: Big Bro {VAR:0103:0}!

strings.en: Yellow: Big Sis {VAR:0103:0}!
strings.notes: D-2274: Yellow's {player}哥哥/姐姐 kept as Big Bro/Big Sis

strings.zh: 小黄『嘿嘿,我凭借自己的实力{NEWLINE}爬到山顶了哦。
strings.en: Yellow: Hee hee, I climbed all the way to{NEWLINE}the summit on my own strength!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『嗯！干得不错啊小黄。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Yeah! Great job, Yellow.

strings.zh: 小蓝『嗨！{VAR:0103:0}！{NEWLINE}这山上够冷的啊,你在这等多久了？
strings.en: Green: Hi, {VAR:0103:0}! It’s freezing up{NEWLINE}here. How long have you been waiting?

strings.zh: 小赤『嗨！{VAR:0103:0}！{NEWLINE}这山上够冷的啊,你在这等多久了？
strings.en: Red: Hi, {VAR:0103:0}! It’s freezing up{NEWLINE}here. How long have you been waiting?

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『哈哈,也没有等多久啦。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Ha ha, not that long.

strings.zh: 小蓝『咦？小银、阿金他们呢？{NEWLINE}我明明看到他们比我先进的山洞,{CLEAR}怎么到山顶了还没见到人啊？
strings.en: Green: Huh? Where are Silver and Gold?{SCROLL}I definitely saw them go into the cave{NEWLINE}before me. How come they’re not at the{CLEAR}summit yet?

strings.zh: 小赤『咦？小银、阿金他们呢？{NEWLINE}我明明看到他们比我先进的山洞,{CLEAR}怎么到山顶了还没见到人啊？
strings.en: Red: Huh? Where are Silver and Gold?{SCROLL}I definitely saw them go into the cave{NEWLINE}before me. How come they’re not at the{CLEAR}summit yet?

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『是啊,我也正纳闷呢,{NEWLINE}以他们的能力,{CLEAR}上山应该不会花太久时间才对。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Yeah, I was wondering that{NEWLINE}too.{SCROLL}With their skills, it shouldn’t take them{NEWLINE}long to get up the mountain.

strings.zh: 阿金『这里除了间小木屋啥都没有,{NEWLINE}都是你这个吊眼红毛领错了路{CLEAR}才会走到这个死胡同来！
strings.en: Gold: There’s nothing here but a little{NEWLINE}cabin!{SCROLL}We ended up in this dead end because{NEWLINE}you led us the wrong way, you{CLEAR}scowling redhead!

strings.zh: 小银『我又没求你跟我走,{NEWLINE}是你自己偷偷跟来的,{CLEAR}就算进了死胡同,也是你自找的！
strings.en: Silver: I never asked you to follow me.{NEWLINE}You snuck after me on your own.{SCROLL}So if we hit a dead end, you asked for{NEWLINE}it!

strings.zh: 阿金『谁知道你平时看起来精明,{NEWLINE}一到关键时候就不中用啊！
strings.en: Gold: Who knew a guy who acts so smart{NEWLINE}all the time would be useless when{CLEAR}it counts!

strings.zh: 小银『那也总好过你这个{NEWLINE}连平时都是一脸呆相的傻瓜。
strings.en: Silver: Still better than you, you idiot.{NEWLINE}You look dopey even on a good day.

strings.zh: 阿金『你说什么！？找揍是不是！
strings.en: Gold: What’d you say!? You looking for a{NEWLINE}beating?!

strings.zh: 小银『哼,打就打,我还怕你不成。
strings.en: Silver: Hmph. Bring it on. Like I’m{NEWLINE}scared of you.

strings.zh: 水晶『好了！你们不要吵了！
strings.en: Crystal: That’s enough! Stop fighting,{NEWLINE}you two!

strings.zh: 水晶『现在回到正确的路线上,{NEWLINE}赶在前8名到达山顶才是最重要的。{CLEAR}你们不是都想挑战{VAR:0103:0}前辈吗？{CLEAR}去晚了可就失去挑战资格了！
strings.en: Crystal: What matters now is getting{NEWLINE}back on the right route and reaching{CLEAR}the summit in the top eight.{SCROLL}Don’t you both want to challenge{NEWLINE}{VAR:0103:0}?{SCROLL}If we’re late, we’ll lose our chance!

strings.zh: 阿金『没错,现在不是{NEWLINE}教训吊眼红毛的时候。
strings.en: Gold: Right. Now’s not the time to teach{NEWLINE}this scowling redhead a lesson.

strings.zh: 小银『懒得理你。
strings.en: Silver: Can’t be bothered with you.

strings.zh: 水晶『明白事情的紧迫性了就赶紧走吧,{NEWLINE}咱们已经耽误很久了,{CLEAR}得抓紧才行！
strings.en: Crystal: Now that you get how urgent{NEWLINE}this is, let’s go!{SCROLL}We’ve already lost a lot of time. We’ve{NEWLINE}got to hurry!

strings.zh: 阿金『野生精灵不要出来碍事！
strings.en: Gold: Wild Pokémon, stay out of my way!

strings.zh: 呃……也不用这么赶时间吧……
strings.en: Er... No need to be in such a rush...

strings.zh: 小银『给我闪一边去！
strings.en: Silver: Out of my way!

strings.zh: 科拿『很遗憾,我认为你的实力{NEWLINE}还达不到精英训练家的水平,{CLEAR}请回吧！
strings.en: Lorelei: I’m sorry, but I don’t think{NEWLINE}you’re at the level of an Ace{CLEAR}Trainer yet.{SCROLL}Please go back.

strings.zh: 嘿嘿,对我来说{NEWLINE}能亲眼见到科拿小姐{CLEAR}就不虚此行了。{CLEAR}谢谢科拿小姐的指点。{CLEAR}我就先回去了！
strings.en: Heh heh. For me, getting to see Miss{NEWLINE}Lorelei in person made the whole trip{CLEAR}worth it.{SCROLL}Thank you for the lesson, Miss Lorelei.{NEWLINE}I’ll be heading back now!

strings.zh: 渡『咱们已经放行过{NEWLINE}多少名训练家上山了？
strings.en: Lance: How many Trainers have we let up{NEWLINE}the mountain so far?

strings.zh: 科拿『我放行了3名,你放行了2名。{NEWLINE}总共是放行5名了。
strings.en: Lorelei: I’ve let three through, and{NEWLINE}you’ve let two through. Five in total.

strings.zh: 渡『还剩三个挑战冠军的名额啊。
strings.en: Lance: So there are three challenger{NEWLINE}spots left.

strings.zh: 科拿『怎么了？{NEWLINE}有你特别在意的训练家还没来吗？
strings.en: Lorelei: What’s wrong? Is there a{NEWLINE}Trainer you’re especially interested in{CLEAR}who hasn’t shown up yet?

strings.zh: 渡『啊,我跟你说过吧。{NEWLINE}在卡吉镇时{CLEAR}跟我们一起闯进火箭队基地的{CLEAR}那几名年轻训练家……
strings.en: Lance: Ah, I told you about them,{NEWLINE}didn’t I?{SCROLL}Those young Trainers who stormed the{NEWLINE}Team Rocket hideout with us in{CLEAR}Mahogany Town...

strings.zh: 水晶『喂喂,阿金,你不要紧吧！
